taxonomic_note: Accepted by current POWO. Older infraspecific names are not assumed to apply to local plants without supporting evidence.
look_here_first: Start with the tiny low habit and very narrow opposite leaves. Then confirm solitary short-axillary lavender flowers rather than the paired bracted cymes of Dicliptera.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Travis is voucher-backed by UT Plant Resources Center; Kerr is voucher-backed by the Flora of Kerr Wildlife Management Area (JS 18024). The Purola/Hays occurrence is explicitly introduced and excluded.

approval_exception.reason: Learner admission is independent from native-range certification. Preserve the two-county HOLD pending a third exact native target-zone county.

best_field_traits: low rhizomatous perennial, often roughly 10–20 cm tall
opposite sessile to subsessile very narrow leaves
purple bilabiate corolla with darker throat markings
capsule largely enclosed by persistent calyx
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Much lower and narrower-leaved than Dicliptera brachiata, with solitary axillary flowers instead of paired condensed cymes with conspicuous bracts.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Low rhizomatous habit + almost linear opposite leaves + solitary axillary flowers.
